item.name: config
item.item:
Allowed image types: jpg, jpeg, png and gif. Recommended image size is 580x390px.
If you're using the barcode element, keep in mind that longer gift codes require wider barcodes for readability. Test the barcode before emailing customers by creating a gift code account in Marketing > Gift Cards > Accounts with your email address. Click 'Save & Send Email' to send the email.
